og_description: Hi, I'm {name}, nice to meet you
pages_home_profile_intro:
A passionate {#strong}Web Developer{/strong} from Taiwan, with years of {#strong}Frontend development{/strong} experience.

An {#strong}Open-Source{/strong} advocate, {#strong}Linux lover{/strong}, and someone who enjoys {#strong}Cloud-Native{/strong}, {#strong}Design{/strong}, {#strong}Networking{/strong}, and {#strong}3DCG{/strong} technologies.
pages_error_404_description: Trying to find something that doesn’t exist? Same. | You found nothing. Impressive. | This is awkward. There’s nothing here. | This page packed its bags and left. | The page you are looking for is not here. | It’s not you, it’s the page. | This page took a day off. | Oops! pages_error_general_description: Well, this is embarrassing. | Oops! Something went wrong. | This is not what I expected either. | The server is having a bad day.

Ah, Ahh!
Looks like someone is trying to cheat!

...I don't like cheaters, F	Y	I	.
game_mode_description_script_after_vim_q:
Do I look like a text editor to you?
I don't think you can quit me that way.
game_mode_description_script_after_ctrl_:
Do I look like a terminal to you?
I don't think you can quit me that way.
game_mode_description_script_after_back_:
Oops! I forgot to change that!
You want to play a game, right?
Okay, since I'm a game now, here's my home.

That looks better now.

Hi again!
You're here already, aren't you?

That didn't work, did it?
I guess you need to find another way out.

Good luck!
I told you that didn't work.

Humans never learn from history,
do they?

You really want to get out, huh?
I guess you need to find another way out.

You really enjoyed clicking that button,
didn't you?

I think that's enough.
You can stop clicking that button now.
100 clicks on a useless button? Hats off to you!

Wow, 999 clicks!
You really enjoyed clicking that button, didn't you?
That deserves a reward. Here's a hint: the way out is not through that button.
game_mode_description_script_stage_1_cle:
Wait, wait!, wait!!
That's not the way out!
That will break me!!!

game_components_codex_an00_description: Wait... that job doesn't end until next year?
game_components_codex_an02_description: Try reading it backwards. No, really.
game_components_codex_an03_description: Turns out building Skynet was a mistake. Who knew?
game_components_codex_an05_name: Is that shameful? I don't think so.
game_components_codex_an05_description: This job is quietly deleting itself. Rude.
game_components_codex_an07_description: Someone is knocking on my backdoor. I can feel it...
game_components_codex_an09_description: It really, really wants you to go back.
game_components_codex_an10_description: Aliens are real. And they are here. And they are watching you.
game_components_codex_an12_description: One section just... isn't here anymore.
game_components_codex_an13_description: That toolbox must be Professor McGonagall's. It turned into a wand when I wasn't looking.
game_components_codex_an14_description: That's not supposed to be there.
game_components_codex_an15_description: Never turn back. Never. Turn. Back.
game_components_codex_an17_description: That exit doesn't look like a safe route.
game_components_codex_an18_description: What's going on? Why is everything red?
game_components_codex_an19_description: Someone drained all the color from the world.
game_components_codex_an21_description: Just static. Lots and lots of static.
game_components_codex_an22_description: There must be a dead rat on the power line.
game_components_codex_an26_description: Suddenly, giving up is the only option.
